evidence_quote: The P2X7 receptor (P2X7R) is an imaging biomarker of glioblastoma-associated microglia/macrophages (GAMMs), yet no SPECT tracer is currently available for GAMM imaging.
rationale: The study develops and evaluates an imaging tracer for glioblastoma-associated microglia/macrophages, directly matching the interest in brain mechanisms and biomarkers for neurological disorders.
